recipes.name: Easy Mushroom Rice
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed French onion soup

steps.text: Gather the ingredients and preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine rice, condensed soup, beef broth, mushrooms, and butter in an 8-inch square casserole dish.
Cover and bake in the preheated oven for 60 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Mushroom Rice
raw_recipe.description: Make mushroom rice in a casserole dish with condensed soup, beef broth, and butter for a scrumptious side dish from a true mix-and-bake recipe!

review.reviewBody:
This was excellent! And so easy. I didn't have any onion soup so I used cream of mushroom instead. Also, I used fresh mushrooms sauteed with an onion and 2 cloves of garlic. I will be making this all the time. It tastes like it took a lot more effort than it does.

*** Update: made it as written for the first time last night and I didn't like it as much. The cream of mushroom version is so much better than the onion soup version! So, as written 4 stars but with cream of mushroom, 5!

Made the recipe with fresh mushrooms and cream of mushroom soup. It was very, very good. I sautéed the mushrooms in the melted butter with some garlic powder and a dash of salt and pepper. Then, I added the rice until it got coated on butter and then added a splash of white wine and let it reduce. After that, I continued the recipe as is, but added about 1 tsp of dried thyme as it marries well with mushrooms....The outcome was excellent. The amount of salt was PERFECT TOO no need to add any more! Will absolutely make it again. Tip: I fluffed the rice halfway through the baking time and covered it again. Then in the last 5 minutes of baking I uncovered it to evaporate any excess moisture. The rice was fluffy and the moisture was just right.

I made this as written and it was great. Then I made it with 1 can of cream of mushroom soup instead of the onion soup and a can of consume. I also sauted the mushrooms with a small finely chopped onion and stirred that in. I baked it for 1 hour, 10 minutes so that the rice was done and stirred half way thru cooking. It was WAY better this way. I baked it in a square tin baking dish and the edges got a bit crispy, so so good!! Thank you for the original recipe and to the members that submitted the changes... without that info I wouldn't have been able to make this dish into so much more of a delicious recipe. Yum

Love this delicious, simple recipe. I did add 1 tsp. Onion Powder
and one cup frozen peas thawed, when rice came out of oven. Smells so good while cooking...As a personal preference, melted the butter before stirring in to mixture. Really a ten star recipe when factoring in ease, taste and minimal prep time and ingredients.
Low sodium soups don't take away from the taste.
I have been making this since the 70’s. Its delicious & always a hit! I also brown pork chops or chicken and bake it on top of the rice for an easy one pan dinner.

I've been making this dish for years. Always a big hit at potlucks and family gatherings. 
 I use 1 can beef consume, 1 can French onion soup, 1/4 cup melted butter and one can of sliced mushrooms with liquid (optional). I pour the cup of uncooked rice (NOT instant rice) in bottom of 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Mix soups, mushrooms with liquid with melted butter in a bowl and pour on top of rice. DO NOT MIX WITH RICE. Bake 350 for 50 minutes. The rice absorbs the liquids. Great with grilled fish and wild game recipes!!

I used a combination of 1 cup brown rice and a 1/4 cup wild rice, a 14.5 oz can low sodium beef broth, French onion soup and a can of mushrooms, drained. I left out the butter and baked it uncovered for 90 minutes, stirring about half way through. Couldn't ask for an easier recipe than this and pretty tasty too. It had a funny aftertaste though; I think I'll try it with 2 cans of low sodium beef broth and a couple teaspoons beef bouillon next time, with a dash of either Soy Sauce or Worchestershire. I think it would taste better if you used fresh mushrooms sautéed in a little olive oil as well and toppled with some thinly sliced green onions or fresh parsley. I am on a quest to find a tasty, simple to prepare, rice side dish to replace the processed boxed varieties that are full of chemicals and preservatives!

Used fresh mushrooms and garlic sauteed in the butter added the ricetil slightly golden added one can beef broth and one lipton onion soup package with 12oz of water. Baked 60 minutes. Outstanding will make again.

I steamed some fresh mushrooms rather than using canned, otherwise, followed the recipe to the letter. Rice came out of the oven at 60 minutes, perfectly cooked and packed with flavor. This recipe takes no effort at all to make, and I was very satisfied with the way it turned out.

This was very good. I followed another readers suggestion about substituting cream of mushroom soup in place of the onion soup. I also sauteed fresh mushrooms in place of can mushrooms along with the onion & garlic that was suggested. My husband loved it, but I felt there was something missing......
Definitely try this one it is good.

The family loved it. The only thing I did differently was I used fresh mushrooms which I sautéed in butter and garlic. My son, who normally doesn't like mushrooms, told me he like how the mushrooms were soft from the sautéing.
great side to Brian's garlicky prime rib

I have been making this recipe since the early 1980's. I lightly toast my rice in a pan with a bit of butter before adding the remaining ingredients. A favorite of family and coworkers. Great for potlucks.
Fantastic, simple hands off, tastes like Beef Rice-Aroni®️ only better. Definitely will be making again.

Super easy and delicious rice! I followed the recipe exactly and loved the result. It was so nice to just throw everything in one dish and then right into the oven. Very little effort and very little clean up! I did not find the dish too salty at all, and felt that it was nicely balanced. Thank you for sharing your recipe!
I made this for my picky husband a few days ago and he loved it! He's been asking me to make more!

This amount of onion soup mix and rice is just too salty to eat. I was served this as a guest and gagged on it because of the salt. I make the recipe using a homemade onion soup mix and using half the amount beef bouillon (the source of all the saltiness) in the recipe. Or, you can use twice the amount of rice and water with 1 package of onion soup mix. If you double the rice and water, add more mushrooms if you are using them.
So easy and lots of flavor. I might add a bit of salt next time, but I like my risotto salty. My son loved i it. I will be making this again.

A good comfort food recipe. However, doesn't quite feel filling enough as a stand-alone main meal. Might be overly saturated with salt, too. Needs an addition but at a loss to say what that might be. Probably wouldn't try again.
